body.cap: Ninewatt introduced its urban-scale energy renovation solution, 'WATTI,’ at CES 2025. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Ninewatt (CEO Kim Youngrok) participated in CES 2025, held in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10 (local time), as part of the Incheon IFEZ Pavilion.

Ninewatt is a South Korean startup specializing in innovative solutions to improve building energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions. Using building energy modeling and public data, Ninewatt diagnoses each building’s current energy efficiency and proposes optimal energy renovation scenarios.

The company’s core products include the WATTI energy renovation platform, the SAVE-E urban energy consumption analysis tool, and the Insight-E electricity cost management solution. Ninewatt highlighted WATTI as its flagship solution during CES 2025.

WATTI is a comprehensive urban energy diagnosis platform that leverages public data to identify priority buildings for energy renovation. It provides simulations to predict energy and carbon reduction outcomes. Municipalities can utilize WATTI for policy decision-making in energy efficiency and carbon reduction, while energy efficiency businesses can easily identify target buildings for renovation projects.
By promoting these advantages, Ninewatt aims to recruit municipalities and businesses interested in adopting its solutions and collaborating on future projects.

body.cap: Ninewatt's representative discussing WATTI with AVING News reporter Alex Sigrist at CES 2025. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: A Ninewatt representative explained, “We plan to establish tailored simulation platforms in overseas regions where green remodeling policies are active. Our services will match local consumers with green remodeling providers.” The company intends to partner with green remodeling companies in Europe and the U.S. and governmental bodies with decision-making authority over urban carbon-neutral initiatives.

The representative added, “To support the expansion of our services and secure funding, we are seeking domestic and international venture capital partners. Additionally, we aim to collaborate with companies in related fields to advance energy efficiency projects. Our primary targets include policymakers overseeing local carbon-neutral policies as we work to align building renovation and energy efficiency projects with municipal subsidies.”
Ninewatt’s presence at CES 2025 underscores its commitment to scaling its innovative solutions globally, contributing to energy efficiency and sustainability in urban areas.

Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
